title: 第七章 天大的任务【求收藏推荐】
novel_title: 方彻最快更新(长夜君主)
content_zh: “乖徒儿，哈哈哈……拿着拿着。”“这是为师珍藏多年的上品灵晶，一共十块，你现在用不着，但是可以放在房间里，修炼的时候吸收溢散灵气，提前接触先天灵气，对修为有好处。”“这是几枚灵魄神丹，吃了后对于魂魄稳固有好处，一会我给你护法，先服用。武者在初始阶段先增强神魂，对未来有巨大的好处。”“这是……”“这是……”“……”孙元兴奋到了极点，他完全能够确定，自己已经成了教派的英雄！这样的天赋，没有被守护者收去成为未来的一大死敌，本身就是一大功绩。未来也是板上钉钉会出成绩的。自己这个伯乐，简直是……想着就要笑出声来，对于自己现在拿出去的毕生积蓄，毫无心疼的感觉：本来就是自己徒弟，衣钵传人，有啥心疼的？而方彻来者不拒，统统收下，更加是毫无心理压力。甚至感觉‘给的太少’。接下来孙元开始检测新徒弟，越是检测，越是喜上眉梢。根骨禀赋协调筋脉经脉反应力，都是超等。“武士四品？”孙元有些奇怪：“你武士四品怎么还没上武院？”按道理来说，武士就足以升武院成为新生了，虽然不至于上顶尖武院，但一般武院，也是很不错的。一旦进了武院，这等材质，怎么可能直到现在还没有师承？“我刚突破武士还没五天。”“没五天？”孙元瞪圆了眼睛。“是啊。”孙元经过严密的盘问与调查，才确定了这件事。事实俱在，兀自不敢相信，眼珠子几乎要掉出来一般问道：“在突破武士之前，平平无奇？突破武士，自己也不知道怎么回事就这样了？”“徒儿你说的是真的？”“这这这……这简直是这这这啊！”孙元感觉自己中了大奖！这应该是天赋异禀，一直没有开启，一直到突破了武士，经脉根骨受到了真元刺激骤然提升的。孙元浑身颤抖了一下，两眼发光的问道：“彻儿，你的毕生梦想是什么？”既然要吸收入教派，这心性是要考察一下的。方彻沉默一下，道：“男儿在世，当凌驾苍生之上，俯瞰红尘生灵；手掌天下权，醉卧美人膝。自由自在，无拘无束；快意恩仇，纵横世间；让天下英雄，皆向我俯首；让这大千世界，任我予取予求！”“好！！”孙元拍腿赞叹，大声叫好。这等心性，这等野心，只需要稍稍引导一下，妥妥我辈中人啊！他本想只要这小家伙不是那种张口仁义道德，闭口天下苍生的正道便好，哪想到这小子居然给了自己一个大大的惊喜！方彻脸上神色不动。就知道你们这帮家伙喜欢这种调调。果然。接下来，孙元迫不及待的想要传授弟子了。“你将你练的功法和拳脚刀剑套路都练给我看看。”方彻开始表演，传统正规基础功法，传统搏击，基础刀剑……“果然只是打了点基础。”孙元露出“果然不出我所料”的神情。这等小家族，培养弟子，也就这样了。“接下来，为师开始传授你真正的武道，帮你打开真正的强者之门！”孙元捋着胡子微笑。“师父，我想要先练身法。”方彻道。“身法？”孙元不解。“是的，身法，可以灵活躲避敌人攻击，而且可以在危机时刻，可以爆发出来数倍，甚至十倍以上的速度，脱离战场，保得平安的那种就最好了。”方彻道。他现在所做的事情，可说是凶险至极。一着不慎，就被自己人干掉了；所以这身法极其重要，也是他真正的心思。而天下这种极限逃命的功夫，莫过于唯我正教的‘燃血术’。燃血术极为神奇，可以瞬间爆发出十倍于平常的速度，而代价，只是一口血！以及事后，虚弱一旦时间。不仅不会损伤根基，甚至连后遗症都没有。可说是这个世间报命逃生第一神功。乃是唯我正教不传之秘。唯我正教高层，不知道多少次依靠燃血术，从正道人士手中逃命。甚至，高出他们一个大境界，都不能追及！对于现在的方彻来说，乃是最最需要的东西，没有之一。现在的问题就在于一点：这个燃血术，不知道孙元会不会，懂不懂？孙元果然面露难色。“按照你这么说的话，倒是有一门功法格外适合，便是我神教的燃血术；只是这燃血术，必须要修为达到宗师以上，而且对教派有重大贡献，才有可能被传授赏赐。”方彻翻個白眼道：“师父您就直接说你会不会吧。”孙元脸上肌肉扭曲：“这个我还真不会。”“……”方彻大失所望，脸上便直接表露出来。我现在只是一个十七岁的少年，喜怒形于色，岂不是太正常的事情嘛？所以他脸上除了失望之外，还有点鄙视也流露了出来。“伱连这都不会，竟然还……”
content_en: "Good disciple, hahaha... take it." "This is a top-grade spiritual crystal that has been treasured by my master for many years. There are ten pieces in total. You don't need it now, but you can put it in the room. During cultivation, you can absorb the overflowing spiritual energy and get in touch with the innate spiritual energy in advance, which is good for your cultivation."These are some spiritual soul pills. After eating them, they will be good for stabilizing the soul. I will protect you later and take them first. It will be of great benefit to the warrior to strengthen his soul in the initial stage.""This is..." "This is..." "..." Sun Yuan was extremely excited. He was absolutely sure that he had become the hero of the sect!It is a great achievement in itself that such a talent is not taken away by the guardian and becomes a mortal enemy in the future.It is certain that there will be results in the future.As a bole myself, I just... laugh out loud just thinking about it. I don't feel any distress at all about the life savings I have now spent: I am my apprentice and heir to the mantle, so why should I feel distressed?Fang Che, on the other hand, did not reject anyone who came and accepted them all, without any psychological pressure.It even feels like ‘too little is given’.Next, Sun Yuan began to test the new apprentice. The more he tested, the more delighted he became.The endowment of the bones and the coordination of the tendons and meridians are all superb."Fourth-grade warrior?" Sun Yuan was a little surprised: "How come you, a fourth-grade warrior, haven't entered the martial arts academy yet?" Logically speaking, a warrior is enough to be promoted to a martial arts academy and become a new student. Although it is not possible to go to the top martial arts academy, the average martial arts academy is also very good.Once you enter the martial arts academy, with such a material, how is it possible that you still haven’t learned from him until now?"It hasn't been five days since I broke through the warrior ranks." "Not five days?" Sun Yuan's eyes widened."Yes." Sun Yuan confirmed this matter after rigorous interrogation and investigation.The facts were all there. He couldn't believe it, and asked as if his eyes were about to pop out: "Before the Breakthrough Samurai, was it just ordinary? The Breakthrough Samurai, you don't know what happened, so it's like this?" "Disciple, are you telling the truth?" "This, this, this... this is this, this, this!" Sun Yuan felt like he had won a big prize!This should be due to an extraordinary talent, which has not been turned on until he breaks through the warrior, and his meridians and bones are suddenly stimulated by the true energy.Sun Yuan trembled all over, and asked with shining eyes: "Che'er, what is your lifelong dream?" Since he wants to be absorbed into the sect, his character needs to be examined.Fang Che was silent for a moment and said: "When a man is alive, he should be above the common people, overlooking the world of mortals; holding the power of the world, lying drunk on the knees of beauties. Be free and unrestrained; grudges and grudges can dominate the world; let all the heroes in the world bow to me; let me take whatever I want in this world!" "Okay!!" Sun Yuan clapped his legs in admiration and cheered loudly.This kind of character, this kind of ambition, just needs a little guidance to be a good person in our generation!He originally thought that as long as this little guy didn't talk about benevolence and morality, but kept silent about the right path of the world, he didn't expect that this kid actually gave him a big surprise!Fang Che's face remained expressionless.I know you guys like this kind of tune.really.Next, Sun Yuan couldn't wait to teach his disciples."Show me all the martial arts and fist, kick, and sword routines you practice." Fang Che began to perform, traditional basic martial arts, traditional fighting, basic swordsmanship... "Sure enough, it's just a basic foundation." Sun Yuan said, "It's just as I expected."This small family can only train disciples."Next, my master will begin to teach you the true martial arts and help you open the door to a real strong man!" Sun Yuan stroked his beard and smiled."Master, I want to practice my body skills first," Fang Che said."Shenfa?" Sun Yuan was puzzled."Yes, the body technique can flexibly avoid enemy attacks, and in times of crisis, it can explode several times or even ten times faster, leaving the battlefield and staying safe is the best." Fang Che said.What he is doing now can be said to be extremely dangerous.If he is not careful, he will be killed by his own people; so this movement technique is extremely important and is also his true intention.And the most extreme escape technique in the world is the 'Blood Burning Technique' of the Solipsism.The blood-burning technique is extremely magical. It can explode ten times faster than normal in an instant, and the cost is only a mouthful of blood!As well as afterwards, weakness once time.Not only will the foundation not be damaged, there will not even be any sequelae.It can be said to be the number one magical skill in the world to report life and escape.This is the secret that only my orthodox religion does not teach.The senior leaders of the Only Self Orthodox Church have relied on the blood-burning technique countless times to escape from the hands of righteous people.Even if it is a level higher than them, they cannot catch up!For Fang Che now, it is the most necessary thing.The problem now is one thing: I wonder if Sun Yuan knows this blood-burning technique, does he understand it?As expected, Sun Yuan looked troubled."According to what you said, there is one technique that is particularly suitable, which is the blood-burning technique of our god's sect. However, for this blood-burning technique, one must reach a master level and make a significant contribution to the sect before it can be taught and rewarded." Fang Che rolled his eyes and said, "Master, just tell me if you know it." Sun Yuan's face muscles twisted: "I really don't know how to do this." "..." Fang Che was greatly disappointed, and it showed directly on his face.I am just a seventeen-year-old boy now, and I am full of joy and anger. Isn’t it normal?So in addition to disappointment, there was also a bit of contempt on his face."You don't even know how to do this, yet you still..."
